name: io.github.Opafex/mcp-approval-queue
description: Human approval gate for AI agents: risk-scored requests that only a person can approve

environmentVariables.description: Directory holding state.json; the server and the CLI must share it (default ~/.opafex/approval-queue)
environmentVariables.name: APPROVAL_QUEUE_STATE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Hours before an undecided request expires (default 24)
environmentVariables.name: APPROVAL_QUEUE_TTL_HOURS
